hotels.title: Heritage Tasmania Countryside Retreat just an Hour from Hobart
hotels.description: Let romance find you at the blissfully secluded Ratho Farm, a boutique country retreat hidden in Tasmania’s lush central highlands. Ideally located a scenic one-hour drive north of Hobart, this charming heritage homestead offers a collection of lavish rooms, all surrounded by the manicured greens of Australia’s oldest golf course. There's simply no finer place to discover the region's charming collection of fine distilleries, wineries and delicious local produce.

hotels.title: Tasmania Heritage Countryside Retreat with Unlimited Golf, Daily Breakfast & Nightly Drinks
hotels.description: Discover world-class golf, renowned nearby distilleries, exceptional trout fishing and rich history at Ratho Farm, a blissfully secluded boutique country retreat hidden in Tasmania’s lush Central Highlands. Ideally located a scenic one-hour drive north of Hobart on the cusp of Bothwell Village, this charming heritage property offers a collection of carefully restored farm cottages, barns, stables and a historic homestead. Encircled by Australia's oldest golf course - established over 150 years ago - this historic estate offers the ideal retreat for Tasmania's festival enthusiasts or those craving escape from the city. Indulge in farm-to-table dining at Atrium restaurant or explore the Central Highlands' celebrated distilleries. Positioned between Hobart and Launceston, it's also the perfect base for discovering nearby treasures like Lake St Clair and Derwent Valley's vineyards.
